title: Honahlea Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Honahlea! Seaside, Fl cottage, walk to the beach or pool! Prime location for a Seaside beach escape for two, or a small family. Sleeps 4!
description_expanded: Description125 GRAYTON STREETKING, 2 TWINSPrime West-End Location in Seaside, FloridaHonahlea is a classic Seaside cottage perfectly positioned just steps down a sandy Seaside footpath from the West End pool and less than a block from Seaside’s private residential beach. This coveted west-side location offers effortless access to the shoreline while keeping you close to the peaceful charm of Seaside’s quieter neighborhoods. A reserved parking space located at the entrance to the cottage path makes arrivals and departures simple and convenient.Thoughtfully Designed Coastal InteriorsInside, Honahlea welcomes you with a comfortable and light-filled living area featuring a dining table, fireplace, large flat-screen TV, and a raised ceiling with a ceiling fan that enhances the home’s airy coastal feel. The living space flows seamlessly into a fully equipped kitchen, complete with a washer and dryer, making longer stays easy and comfortable.Sleeping Arrangements for Relaxed Seaside LivingThe primary bedroom features a king-size bed, ceiling fan, and easy access to a full bathroom with an oversized soaking tub and separate shower—perfect for unwinding after a day at the beach. Just a few steps up from the living area, a charming loft offers two twin beds, creating a cozy and functional sleeping space ideal for children.Inviting Outdoor SpacesThe living area opens onto a serene front porch furnished with a ceiling fan, dining table, and comfortable chaise lounge seating for two. Overlooking a private yard and a live oak–shaded footpath, this peaceful porch is the perfect place to enjoy morning coffee or an evening glass of wine. An enclosed outdoor shower and charcoal grill are conveniently located just off the porch, adding to the ease of coastal living.Architectural SignificanceHonahlea was designed by award-winning architect Scott Merrill, the visionary behind the iconic Seaside Chapel. Merrill was honored with the Seaside Prize in 2012, making this cottage not only a charming retreat but also a meaningful piece of Seaside’s architectural legacy.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. * There is active construction adjacent to the property. Guests should anticipate daytime noise and construction-related activity. We are unable to control or predict daily work schedules.FEATURES480 square feet176 yards | 2-minute walk to beach accessPrivate Seaside residential beach access at Natchez Pavilion — featuring one-half mile of private shoreline, the largest stretch of private beach on 30AStackable washer & dryerPeacock Alley Linens — fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley sheets and towels throughout the homeAccess to amenities — 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote — includes 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking & golf cart policy — 1 parking pass issued per one-bedroom cottage. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002399
